description: This file defines classes and templates for handling Netlink messaging, including message parameters, frame parsing, and socket communication, specifically for Linux systems. It includes classes for Netlink message construction, parsing, and socket management, with focus on kernel communication via Netlink sockets.

classes.name: Netlink
classes.description: Base class for Netlink message handling, including serialization, deserialization, and message parameters.

classes.name: Netlink::Parameters
classes.description: Template class for constructing Netlink message parameters with buffer management.

classes.name: Netlink::Frames
classes.description: Class for iterating over and validating Netlink message frames within a received data buffer.

classes.name: Netlink::ConnectorType
classes.description: Template class for specific Netlink connector message types, handling acknowledgment and message parsing.

classes.name: SocketNetlink
classes.description: Derived class managing Linux Netlink socket communication, including sending, receiving, and message exchange.

classes.name: SocketNetlink::Message
classes.description: Inner class representing a message with state management for sending and receiving over Netlink socket.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the Netlink message into a byte stream.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a byte stream into a Netlink message.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a Netlink message over the socket, optionally waiting for acknowledgment.

methods.name: Exchange
methods.description: Performs a send and receive operation for Netlink messages.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Internal method to send data through the socket buffer.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Internal method to receive data from the socket buffer.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles state changes in socket communication.
